label: HOBBY 1
head: Learn to fight
sub: Jiu-jitsu, wrestling or boxing. You learn to think while someone tries to hurt you.

label: HOBBY 2
head: Build endurance
sub: Run, swim, hike for hours. Just you and your own thoughts.

label: HOBBY 3
head: Work with your hands
sub: Woodwork, fixing engines, welding. Patience and detail you can't fake.

label: HOBBY 4
head: Play chess
sub: Thinking 3 moves ahead works on a board and in real life.

label: HOBBY 5
head: Cook for your people
sub: Timing, patience, and feeding the people under your roof.

head: Your evenings
l: Rolls at the gym, then cooks dinner

text: Being capable in 5 areas builds *confidence you can't fake.*
